name: ZSP_JOBS
description: This table is used to store the summary information for a batch/job.

columns.name: JOB_CODE
columns.description: Primary Key for the table.

columns.name: JOB_OPTY_EVENT_LEARNED_NUM
columns.description: Total number of events corresponding to above opportunities that are learned by the model for a job.

columns.name: JOB_OPTY_CLOSED_LEARNED_NUM
columns.description: Total number of closed opportunities that are learned by the model for a job and can be used for prediction

columns.name: EARLIEST_OPTY_CLOSE_DT
columns.description: The earliest close date of all opportunities for a job

columns.name: LATEST_OPTY_CLOSE_DT
columns.description: The latest close date of all opportunities for a job

columns.name: JOB_RECOMMEND_NUM
columns.description: Number of recommendations created so far.

columns.name: JOB_RECOMMEND_CUST_NUM
columns.description: Total number of customers which will be processed for this job. Used for both training and lead gen jobs.

columns.name: JOB_LEARNED_CUST_NUM
columns.description: Number of customers processed so far. Used for both training and lead gen jobs.

columns.name: CURRENT_TASK_CODE
columns.description: TASK_CODE for currently active task.  Link to ZSP_TASKS for task description.  Null for jobs that are not currently running.

columns.name: END_STATUS
columns.description: Status of current job. All possible values are ???Succeeded???, ???Failed???, ???Canceled??? or null.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_RECOMMEND_SELECTED
columns.description: Number of recommendations selected for a job.

columns.name: JOB_LEAD_IMPORTED
columns.description: Number of leads imported for a job.

columns.name: JOB_CUST_RECOMMEND_SELECTED
columns.description: Count of customers whose recommendations are selected in leads preview report.

columns.name: JOB_CUST_LEAD_IMPORTED
columns.description: Count of customers whose leads are imported in leads preview report.

columns.name: TRAINING_JOB_NAME
columns.description: TRAINING_JOB_NAME
